name: Spreadsheets
summary: Tabular business data maintained in spreadsheets, often the operational backbone of SMBs.
whatItContains: Rows and columns of structured data, formulas, multiple tabs, and change history.
whatAiCanDoWithIt: Auto-populate rows from form submissions or emails
Generate weekly summary narratives from KPI tabs
Flag overdue items in tracker sheets
Clean and normalize messy manual entries
accessMethod: Google Sheets API, Airtable API, or CSV import
